records.jp: こういうステージで演奏する人ってかっこいいよね！
records.en_original: People who perform at places like this are so cool.
records.en: People who perform at places like this are so cool.

records.jp: 私もみんなの注目を集めて、<CR>キャーキャー言われてみたい！
records.en_original: I wanna hear a big crowd calling my name someday too!
records.en: I wanna hear a big crowd calling my name someday too!

records.jp: 星崎さんは、ステージに立ってみたいんですか？
records.en_original: You have an interest in performing, Ao?
records.en: You have an interest in performing, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: うん！　誰だって学園祭でバンドをやって、<CR>ギターボーカルになる妄想をするでしょ？
records.en_original: Of course! I think everyone's imagined themselves as the front man of their own band.
records.en: Of course! I think everyone's imagined themselves as the front man of their own band.

records.jp: ……なるほど、そういうものなのですね。<CR>ギターも練習したりしたのですか？
records.en_original: Everyone, you say... Do you have any experience with the guitar or other instruments?
records.en: Everyone, you say... Do you have any experience with the guitar or other instruments?

records.jp: 練習すれば、きっと妄想も現実にできますよ？<CR>私、星崎さんがステージに上がるのを見てみたいです
records.en_original: You could really make it happen if you practice enough, don't you think? I'd be interested in seeing you on the stage as well.
records.en: If you practice, you can surely make that fantasy a reality.<CR>I'd like to see you take the stage, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: 妄想の中にはね……。<CR>辛い練習は含まれてないんだよ……
records.en_original: But I don't have to practice in my daydreams...
records.en: But I don't have to practice in my daydreams...

records.jp: 美味しい思いをしたい。でもそのための努力は<CR>したくないから、人は妄想で満足するんだ……
records.en_original: The best part of fantasies is you get all the good stuff without having to do any of the work.
records.en: The best part of fantasies is you get all the good stuff without having to do any of the work.

records.jp: 人間とは業が深いものですね……
records.en_original: I see that there is no limit to human greed...
records.en: I see that there is no limit to human greed...

records.jp: まあ、聞いてるだけで楽しいから、音楽はそれで十分。<CR>詩さんは音楽好き？
records.en_original: I have plenty of fun just listening, so I'm satisfied with that. Do you like music, Uta?
records.en: I have plenty of fun just listening, so I'm satisfied with that. Do you like music, Uta-san?

records.jp: 好きですよ。<CR>私のような人間の心も動かしてくれるので……
records.en_original: I do. I find it able to stir the heart of even a person like me.
records.en: I do. I find it able to stir the heart of even a person like me.

records.jp: いやいや、とても無理だって！<CR>平凡だし、わりと人前であがるし、音楽できないし
records.en_original: No way! I'd be so nervous. Besides, I can't play any instruments or sing.
records.en: No way! I'd be so nervous. Besides, I can't play any instruments or sing.

records.jp: 元は内気な人が、ステージに上がる時のための<CR>別の人格を演じる場合もあるそうですよ
records.en_original: I've heard many shy performers have to pretend to be another person to get on stage.
records.en: I've heard many shy performers have to pretend to be another person to get on stage.

records.jp: へぇ……そういうものなんだ。<CR>詩さんって、物知りだよね
records.en_original: Huh, interesting. You sure know a lot, Uta.
records.en: Huh, interesting. You sure know a lot, Uta-san.

records.jp: 以前の私は、自分を理解しようとして<CR>いろいろな本を読みました。それだけです
records.en_original: I believe my old self used to read often in an attempt to understand herself.
records.en: I believe my old self used to read often in an attempt to understand herself.

records.jp: 自分を演じる……私にはできませんが、<CR>それだけ音楽をやりたかったんですね
records.en_original: I don't think I'd be able to pretend to be another person, but... I was interested in playing music.
records.en: I don't think I'd be able to pretend to be another person, but... I was interested in playing music.

records.jp: 私、音楽もそんなに知らないんだけど、<CR>詩さんはどんな音楽が好き？
records.en_original: I'm not super knowledgeable, but what kind of music do you like, Uta?
records.en: I'm not super knowledgeable, but what kind of music do you like, Uta-san?

records.jp: どんな……というのは難しいですが……<CR>そうですね……
records.en_original: What kind? That's difficult to answer...
records.en: What kind? That's difficult to answer...

records.jp: 私が私でいることを赦してくれるような気持ちになる<CR>曲に出会うと、嬉しかったです
records.en_original: I always liked songs that made me feel like it was okay to be myself.
records.en: I always liked songs that made me feel like it was okay to be myself.

records.jp: 自分が自分でいることは、誰かに赦されなきゃ<CR>いけないものでもないと思うけどなー……
records.en_original: I think it's okay to be yourself no matter what...
records.en: I think it's okay to be yourself no matter what...

records.jp: もし、あの頃……いえ。<CR>星崎さんは、どんな音楽が好きなんですか？
records.en_original: If I had known you back then... No, never mind. What kind of music do you like, Ao?
records.en: If I had known you back then... No, never mind. What kind of music do you like, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: やっぱアニソンかなぁ。好きなアニメのやつ。<CR>……とか言うと、ちょっと恥ずかしいかな
records.en_original: I like anime music a lot. Though it's a little embarrassing to admit...
records.en: I like anime music a lot. Though it's a little embarrassing to admit...

records.jp: 恥ずかしい……どうしてですか？
records.en_original: Embarrassing? Why?
records.en: Embarrassing? Why?

records.jp: やっぱ趣味が趣味っていうか、カッコ悪いかなぁってさ<CR>……同じオタク相手に言うならともかく……あはは
records.en_original: I don't know, my hobbies are pretty lame. I don't mind talking about them with other geeks, but it's a little embarrassing otherwise.
records.en: I don't know, my hobbies are pretty lame. I don't mind talking about them with other geeks, but it's a little embarrassing otherwise.

records.jp: カッコ悪い……変なことを言うんですね。<CR>私のどんな話でも、きちんと聞いてくれた人なのに
records.en_original: Lame...? What a strange thing to say. I wouldn't judge you based on your hobbies alone.
records.en: Lame...? What a strange thing to say. I wouldn't judge you based on your hobbies alone.

records.jp: 好きなものをしっかりと持っている……<CR>私はむしろ、羨ましいですよ？
records.en_original: You have things you truly enjoy. If anything, I think I'm jealous of that.
records.en: You have things you truly enjoy. If anything, I think I'm jealous of that.

records.jp: 音楽っていったら、やっぱクラシックかなぁ？<CR>あの荘厳な感じがたまらないっていうか！
records.en_original: If I had to decide on just one genre, classical I think. It just feels so majestic.
records.en: If I had to decide on just one genre, classical I think. It just feels so majestic.

records.jp: 荘厳……ですか？　つまり、音が厚いということ……？<CR>そうすると、交響曲のあたり……でしょうか？
records.en_original: Majestic...? Then do you prefer symphonic arrangements over something like a quartet?
records.en: Majestic...? Then do you prefer symphonic arrangements over something like a quartet?

records.jp: わー！　ごめんなさいっ！<CR>ちょっと見栄張っちゃいました！
records.en_original: Waaah, I was lying! I'm sorry, I don't know anything about classical music!
records.en: Waaah, I was lying! I'm sorry, I don't know anything about classical music!

records.jp: えっ。いきなり何故、謝るんですか？
records.en_original: Hm? What do you mean?
records.en: Hm? What do you mean?

records.jp: だって、私が知ってるクラシックって、<CR>アニメで流れるやつで、あとは全然知らないし！！
records.en_original: The only classical music I know is the stuff that shows up in anime!
records.en: The only classical music I know is the stuff that shows up in anime!

records.jp: ……でも、その曲は好きなんですよね？<CR>それなら、いいじゃないですか
records.en_original: But you do like those songs, correct? I think that's all that matters.
records.en: But you do like those songs, correct? I think that's all that matters.

records.jp: そ、そっかな……
records.en_original: I-I guess...
records.en: I-I guess...

records.jp: 何だか、自分の世界って狭いなーって<CR>思えてきたよ……
records.en_original: Makes me feel like my own world and what I like is pretty small...
records.en: Makes me feel like my own world and what I like is pretty small...

records.jp: それなら……お揃いですね。<CR>世界が狭いのは、きっと私の方が上ですから
records.en_original: In that respect, we're not so different. I'm sure my world is even smaller than yours.
records.en: In that respect, we're not so different. I'm sure my world is even smaller than yours.

records.jp: でも……好きな音楽の話をするなんて、初めてです。<CR>自分が何を好きか、真剣に考えることができました
records.en_original: But... This is the first time I've ever spoken to someone about what music I like. I had never really thought about it much before.
records.en: But... This is the first time I've ever spoken to someone about what music I like. I had never really thought about it much before.

records.jp: 好きなものの話をするのって、楽しいんですね
records.en_original: Talking about the things I like...it's fun.
records.en: Talking about the things I like...it's fun.

records.jp: ……そうだ！
records.en_original: Oh, speaking of!
records.en: Oh, speaking of!

records.jp: これからさ、一緒にいろんな曲を聴いて、<CR>好きな曲をもっと探そうよ！
records.en_original: We should listen to a bunch of different kinds of music together sometime! That way we can find new music we like.
records.en: We should listen to a bunch of different kinds of music together sometime! That way we can find new music we like.

records.jp: たしか放送室にいろんなCDあったし、<CR>みんなのスマホにもいろいろ入ってると思うし！
records.en_original: I'm sure there are all kinds of CDs in the broadcasting room, and I bet everyone's got music on their phones!
records.en: I'm sure there are all kinds of CDs in the broadcasting room, and I bet everyone's got music on their phones!

records.jp: それは、楽しそうです。<CR>星崎さんがどんな曲を気に入るのか、興味があります
records.en_original: That sounds fun. I'd be interested to see what songs you like.
records.en: That sounds fun. I'm interested in what kind of songs you'll like, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: 私は詩さんが気に入るやつを知りたいー！
records.en_original: And I'm interested to see what you like!
records.en: I want to know what you'll like, Uta-san!

records.jp: ……今の私は、昔とは違う傾向のものに<CR>心を惹かれるかもしれません
records.en_original: I expect I'll have different preferences compared to what I used to enjoy.
records.en: I expect I'll have different preferences compared to what I used to enjoy.

records.jp: 私も！　そういうのも楽しみだよね！<CR>それで、全然趣味が合わなかったりして
records.en_original: Me too! I think that's what makes it exciting! Like, what if our tastes our completely different.
records.en: Me too! I think that's what makes it exciting! Like, what if our tastes our completely different.

records.jp: ふふ。それも楽しいこと……なんでしょうね……
records.en_original: Hehe... I suppose that could be fun as well.
records.en: Hehe... I suppose that could be fun as well.

records.jp: 私、詩さんの好きな曲を聴いてみたいなぁ……
records.en_original: I'd love to hear your favorite song.
records.en: I'd like to hear your favorite song, Uta-san...

records.jp: でも、以前の私は曲名に興味を持ちませんでした。<CR>ですから……
records.en_original: Unfortunately, the old me had no interest in the names of songs. I have no idea what it's called.
records.en: Unfortunately, the old me had no interest in the names of songs. I have no idea what it's called.

records.jp: じゃあさ、学校の中をいろいろ探してみようよ！<CR>同じ曲じゃなくても、好きな曲が見つかるかもだよ！
records.en_original: Let's take a look around the school! We may not find that specific song, but we may find others you like!
records.en: Let's take a look around the school! We may not find that specific song, but we may find others you like!

records.jp: 詩さんの心を揺さぶったものなら、きっとどこかに<CR>眠ってるよ！　だって、想いでできてる世界なんだから
records.en_original: I bet there's a song hiding somewhere here that you used to like! This is a world made up of our memories and emotions after all!
records.en: If it moved your heart, Uta-san, it must be sleeping somewhere! This is a world made of feelings, after all!

records.jp: ふふ。そうかも、しれませんね
records.en_original: Hehe. That may be true.
records.en: Hehe. That may be true.

records.jp: でも、どうして……いえ。<CR>聴きたいと言ってくれて、嬉しいです
records.en_original: But why would you... No, I'm happy that you've taken an interest in me.
records.en: But why would you... No, I'm happy that you've taken an interest in me.

records.jp: そんな改まって言われると照れるよ
records.en_original: It's embarrassing when you say it like that!
records.en: It's embarrassing when you say it like that!

records.jp: もしその曲が見つかったら……<CR>星崎さんがどう感じるかを、ぜひ聞きたいです
records.en_original: If I ever find a song like that... I'd love to hear what you think of it.
records.en: If we find that song... I'd really like to hear how you feel about it, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
